parsed.notes:
Essential Skills is required; Beneficial Skills is optional. Responsibilities and company descriptions do not supply additional labels.
Unmapped entries through hand-eye calibration are required; subsequent unmapped entries are nice-to-have.
OpenCV collapses into computer-vision under the supplied taxonomy; the required computer-vision mention wins.
Dataset versioning is not treated as model versioning, and continuous training/evaluation pipelines are not assumed to mean CI/CD or data-ingestion pipelines.
Alternative groups contain only mapped skills and require at least two members. Machine learning and computer vision are also asked for independently, so the initial experience alternatives do not produce a retained group.
Robotics and industrial automation as general domains, publication history, English fluency, and adaptability are excluded. Concrete robotics techniques, tools, and platforms are retained.
NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Lab is read literally as naming Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab. AGX and Xavier are retained as written without inferring more specific product variants.
